model.description: The unique identifier of the Ensemble LLM which generated this vote.

ensemble_index.description: The index of the Ensemble LLM in the Ensemble.

flat_ensemble_index.description: The flat index of the Ensemble LLM in the expanded Ensemble, accounting for counts.

vote.description: The vote generated by this Ensemble LLM. It is of the same length of the number of responses provided in the request. If the Ensemble LLM used logprobs, may be a probability distribution; otherwise, one of the responses will have a value of 1 and the rest 0.

weight.description: The weight assigned to this vote.

retry.description: Whether this vote came from a previous Vector Completion which was retried. `from_cache` will also be `true`.

from_cache.description: Whether this vote came from the global ObjectiveAI votes cache.

from_rng.description: Whether this vote was generated via RNG.

items.description: A vote from an Ensemble LLM within a Vector Completion.

votes.description: The list of votes for responses in the request from the Ensemble LLMs within the provided Ensemble.

scores.description: The scores for each response in the request, aggregated from the votes of the Ensemble LLMs.

weights.description: The weights assigned to each response in the request, aggregated from the votes of the Ensemble LLMs.

description: The output of a vector completion task.
